style: Avant-garde art-rock cabaret and intense Balkan communal dance-band fusion. Harmony uses subharmonic undertone fields with microtonal pure interval friction and 12-TET sliding dyads. Melody features angular phrasing with yodel register flips, glottal Ubykh consonant stops, and contour-carrying rests. Rhythm uses polymetric 5:4 and polyrhythmic 3:2 under contact-pulse exertion decay, nested tuplets, and tempo canon. Timbre combines daxophone, gamelan metallophones, bağlama, kamancheh, santur, zurna, duduk, and riq. Performance attitude is trashy spectacle colliding with domestic afterglow. Production uses extreme-latency radio transmission with close-miked acoustic instruments, harsh breath transients, and analog room decay.
lyrics:
[SECTION 1: DISORIENTATION AND RE-ENTRY]
[TEMPORAL ENGINE: REVERSE CHRONOLOGY INITIATED]
[SOUND SOURCE EXPOSURE: KAMANCHEH AND SANTUR]
[VOCAL TOPOLOGY: SIMULTANEOUS TRANSLATION CHOIR]

[Voice 1 - English with Ubykh L1 Transfer]
I slammed back into the meat again.
The wet walls fit too tight.
Every morning is a violence against the floorboards.
[Voice 2 - Overlapping translation chorus]
The cartilage clicks like a dry riq.
I want it off of me.
The stuff is too dense.
[Instrumental Interruption: Zurna high-register call, untuned reed shriek]
[Constraint Check: One new fact established — the meat is heavy]
[Audience Score Check: 14 points — threshold unreached, progression held]

[SECTION 2: ABERRANT SALIENCE AND DOMESTIC TERROR]
[SOUND SOURCE EXCHANGE: BAĒLAMA LEAD OVER GAMELAN PULSE]
[PHYSICAL GESTURE: CONTACT PULSE WITH EXERTION DECAY]

[Voice 1]
I washed the breakfast ceramic.
Every speck of grease on the porcelain holds the weight of a dying star.
[Voice 2]
The toast crumbs are geological layers.
I am trapped in an administrative nightmare of thumbs and fingernails.
[Rhythmic Cue: Contact pulse on wooden table, slowing down due to fatigue]
[Economy Check: Rare word license used — 'geological']
[Failure Check: Checkpoint restart triggered — repeat previous line with altered pitch class]
[Voice 1 - Restarted]
The toast crumbs are topological maps of my own digestion.
[Zurna interjection: sharp, piercing, unyielding]

[SECTION 3: THE DAKOPHONE GROAN AND THE MEAT PROBLEM]
[SOUND SOURCE: DAXOPHONE VOCAL-LIKE TONGUE FRICTION]
[ROLE EXCHANGE: ACCOMPANIMENT TAKES LEAD]

[Daxophone solo: speech-like groans, wooden vowels, unstable pitch sliding across 12-TET grid]
[Voice 1 - Whispered translation under daxophone lead]
Listen to the wood groan.
It has fewer problems than the femur.
It does not complain about the humidity of the skin.
[Voice 2]
We are pickled in our own water.
[Nested Tuplet Rhythm: 5 against 7 subdivision on riq frame drum]
[Constraint Check: Every event gets explained later — marked marker set]

[SECTION 4: THE DELAYED EXPLANATION]
[TEMPORAL CAUSALITY REVERSAL]
[SOUND SOURCE: DUDUK DRONE WITH SANTUR TREMOLO CASCADE]

[Voice 1]
The reason the femur aches is the collision of last Tuesday's dream with gravity.
[Voice 2]
We deferred the explanation until the marrow cooled.
Now the marrow is cold.
The explanation arrives late through the extreme-latency radio channel.
[Static burst, transmission drop, audio compression artifacts]
[Score unlock: 50 points reached — new register unlocked]

[SECTION 5: THE CELEBRATION OF THE TRASHY DOMESTIC]
[TEMPO CANON: TWO LAYERS AT 2:3 RATIO]
[PERFORMANCE: TRASHY SPECTACLE WITH ZERO SHAME]

[Massed Chorus - Full Ensemble]
Oh look at the dish soap bubbles!
They are glorious cheap galaxies!
We are garbage kings in a wet porcelain palace!
[Zurna counterpoint, baĒlama frantic tremolo, santur glittering cascade]
[Voice 1]
I hate the meat!
[Voice 2]
I love the toast!
[Voice 1 and 2 in sharp friction]
Both are true simultaneously!
[Rhythmic acceleration through exhaustion decay]
[Final Duxophone squeal cut off abruptly by structural silence]
[OPERATIONAL LOGGING: VERIFYING SYSTEM STABILITY DURING EXTENDED PHONETIC EXPANSION PROTOCOLS]
[ADDITIONAL CONTEXT: THE SUB-BASS OSCILLATOR MAINTAINS A 432 HERTZ DRONE BENEATH THE SURFACE DUST OF THE METRONOME]
[DIAGNOSTIC TRACE REPORT: AMPLIFIER CHANNELS BALANCED AT NEGATIVE SIX DB WITH WARM HARMONIC DISTORTION IN THE MID-RANGE]
[ARCHIVAL NOTE: RECURSIVE LOOPS ARE MONITORED BY THE CENTRAL PROCESSING UNIT TO ENSURE NO DRIFT OCCURS ACROSS THE STEREO FIELD]
[END OF SYSTEM LOG SEQUENCE: READY FOR NEXT CYCLE SUBMISSION]
[END]
caption: An avant-garde art-rock cabaret colliding with Balkan dance-band instrumentation. Driven by Ubykh-influenced vocal phrasing, simultaneous translation choirs, and an eight-instrument acoustic palette including daxophone, gamelan, bağlama, and zurna. Explores the existential horror of waking up trapped in biological matter through reverse chronology, nested tuplets, extreme-latency radio transmission, and trashy domestic surrealism under strict compositional rules.
